description: This script processes clang-format error logs to generate a JUnit XML report, identifying formatting errors in source files and constructing an XML report for test results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that checks for errors in the clang-format log, constructs an XML report if errors are found, and exits with a message if formatting issues are detected.

methods.name: createErrorList
methods.description: Parses the clang-format error log file and returns a list of errors with associated filenames and error information.
